caption: The drawing depicts a single duck decoy object positioned in profile, facing left, centered against a plain, light beige background. The decoy has a rounded body with a rich, dark brown color, accented by lighter brown and reddish hues on its head and upper body. The bill is olive green, fading to yellow at the tip. The body displays a pattern of feather shapes outlined in a slightly lighter brown, with a small patch of dark green near the rear wing area. The eye is round and yellowish. The decoy's surface appears smooth with some reflective highlights, and the base of the decoy sits flat against the background, which is unadorned except for a few small, faint smudges and marks near the duck and at the top of the image.
title: Wooden Duck
